housing.text: Gonzales lists building new housing and expanding first-time homebuyer programs among his campaign priorities.
housing.quote: Build New Housing and expand programs to help first-time homebuyers.

schools.text: Gonzales says he would support local schools and expand access to early education.
schools.quote: Improve Local Schools and expand access to early education.

energy.text: Gonzales proposed increasing the state climate credit to offset higher utility costs in Kern County.
energy.quote: We pay more in the summer months than most other parts of the state, we should receive a higher credit in order to offset the increased cost in utilities

safety.text: Ayon, a former Kern County sheriff's deputy, campaigns on supporting law enforcement and public safety.
safety.quote: Support law enforcement, restore accountability, and ensure every family can feel safe in their neighborhood.
